summary: Faz-4 Strategy Control Governance Testing Complete. All backend endpoints (22 tests) passed and frontend UI verified. Features tested: feedback loop with strategy+drift context validation, immutable append with dataset version increment, model update lifecycle (queued->running->completed simulation), timeline export (JSON+CSV with drift+action+feedback combined), and ops user 403 authorization.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/admin/futures/strategy/{id}/feedback-label: Properly validates strategy+drift context match, returns rejected if mismatch
Feedback entries are immutable (append-only) with dataset_version increment on each new entry
GET /api/admin/futures/strategy/{id}/feedback: Supports filtering by drift_alert_id and taxonomy query params
POST /api/admin/futures/strategy/{id}/trigger-model-update: Creates queued job, blocks concurrent jobs with 'zaten var' message
GET /api/admin/futures/strategy/{id}/model-update-status: Returns current_job with status lifecycle (queued->running->completed after 4s+8s)
GET /api/admin/futures/strategy/{id}/timeline-export: Returns combined drift+action+feedback events, supports JSON and CSV formats
All Faz-4 endpoints return response contract {status, trace_id, message, state_snapshot}
All Faz-4 endpoints properly enforce super_admin authorization (ops users get 403)
Frontend Audit/History tab shows: Feedback Loop panel with all form fields, Model Update Trigger with status card, Timeline Export panel
Frontend Feedback Log shows immutable entries with version numbers (v1, v2, v3...)
Frontend Model Update status card shows current_status, job_id, history_count with auto-refresh polling

success_rate.frontend: 100% (All UI elements verified: feedback form, related data slice fields, model update trigger+status, export panel with JSON/CSV)

seed_data_creation: None required - used existing strategies and drift alerts from pipeline
